summary: Full backend + frontend Phase 1 testing for Cluster Nationals 2026-27. 30/30 pytest backend tests passed against the external URL (health, dashboard aggregation, teams CRUD, buildings/floors/rooms hierarchy CRUD, knowledge CRUD with tags round-trip and category/status filters, procurement CRUD with numeric persistence incl. Decimal target_unit_price/max_budget, announcements CRUD, public teams field-safety, public announcements filtering, and global search across teams/rooms/knowledge/procurement/announcements). Frontend Playwright E2E across public home, public teams (search filter works with 'Saudi'), admin dashboard (all stat cards render live numbers: Teams=4, Participants=84, Rooms=1/15, Procurement=2 open, Tasks=2), Admin Teams add+delete flow, Admin Knowledge add + filter presence, Admin Procurement add with qty, Admin Announcements add and cross-verified on public /announcements, and Admin top-bar global search dropdown returned expected 'Mattress' results grouped by type. No blockers found.
critical_code_review_comments: Knowledge tags are stored as comma-separated string in a text column; if any user tag itself contains a comma it will be split incorrectly on read. Consider a JSON/ARRAY column or explicit delimiter escaping.

search.py issues 5 separate queries per request with no index hints; fine for Phase 1 seed sizes but should switch to a full-text index (pg_trgm/tsvector) before scaling to hundreds of records per entity.
Procurement router does not validate that status is in PROCUREMENT_STATUSES on create/update (only default). Consider a Literal / validator to prevent free-form values that would break UI filters.
Announcements: is_published toggling does not update published_at automatically anywhere visible in the router logic exposed; verify server-side timestamp is set when transitioning from False->True.

No auth on admin routes is intentional for Phase 1, but /api/teams (with contact_email/phone) is fully open on the public network. Ensure this is documented and gated behind auth before Phase 2 go-live.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_* rows during backend tests (cleaned up by tests themselves) and TEST_UI_* rows via UI tests; cleaned via API after UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_cluster_nationals_api.py and runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 30 tests pass. If seed is wiped, run: cd /app/backend && python -m app.seed. UI data-testids used: nav-*, hero-*, public-teams, team-grid, team-search-input, admin-dashboard, stat-{teams,participants,rooms,transport,procurement,tasks}, add-team-btn, team-dialog, team-name-input, save-team-btn, delete-team-{id}, add-knowledge-btn, knowledge-dialog, knowledge-title-input, save-knowledge-btn, filter-category, filter-status, add-procurement-btn, procurement-title-input, procurement-qty-input, save-procurement-btn, add-announcement-btn, announcement-title-input, announcement-message-input, save-announcement-btn, global-search-input, global-search-results.
